messages.author: 98820c8be152519f
messages.subject: About Korean Fonts
parts:
Hi...

I tried text-mining example based in korean-language. 
In rstudio console (glimmer.rstudio.com), there seemed to be no problem in korean-fonts.
But in plot area, korean characters were shown just like a rectangular shape. 
I guess this problem came from not-supporting korean-fonts in shiny rstudio-server. 
Can I ask you to install korean fonts in shiny rstudio-server? 

I think it'would be much more great if shiny supports korean fonts.

messages.author: 98820c8be152519f
messages.subject: Re: About Korean Fonts
parts:
How about trying this...

sudo apt-get install language-pack-ko language-pack-ko-base

I found that way at korean ubuntu community (http://www.ubuntu.or.kr/viewtopic.php?p=60298)

This community guided that after installing, user should change ~/.profile file to add some config like this...

LANG=ko_KR.UTF-8
LANGUAGE=ko_KR.UTF-8



2012/11/30 Joe Cheng [RStudio] <j...@rstudio.org>

Anyone know what Ubuntu package(s) to install to resolve this? Preferably from the official respository?
